== Notes ==
* Synergy with [[Arcane Echo]] (and [[:Category:Skills that cause Skill Copying|other copying skills]]), since whenever the copying skill becomes another skill it instantly starts off  recharged, and the copy eventually expires, nullifying the added recharge.
